item.tib: zab mo gnad kyi gdams pa dngos gzhi
item.coloph: de ltar snyan rgyud yang snying man ngag dgongs pa'i bcud/ zab don gnad kyi gdams pa mthar thug pa/ dngos gzhi lag khrid go rim bde bar bkod/ snod ldan kun gyi don du 'gyur bar shog rgyud smin cing grol bar byed pa 'od gsal dngos gzhi'i gdams pa'o/ las med log lta can la tshig tsam mi bsgrag go/ u ya/
